review_basis:
Fourteenth golden, a THIRD sheet mined from the same NAVFAC Cherry Point ATC Tower project (development goldens now on MH102 and MH121, held-out on MH101 -- all three deliberately different sheets). This is the tower's own diagonal-footprint floor 1 ductwork plan. A wide render crop near an exhaust fan (EF-T1) showed a real, clean 6-inch round exhaust-air (EA) duct connector: a diagonal segment from a real elbow at the fan's own round duct connection down to a second real elbow where it turns to run horizontally toward another branch.

`trace_run` reaches this segment cleanly (6.37 LF, matching the visible diagonal run in the crop) with BOTH ends `ambiguous` at the two real elbows (each a genuine direction change, not an engine misread -- confirmed via a marked render crop showing both endpoints sitting exactly on the drawn corners). Unlike this project's other rejected pipe candidates this session (MP104, M-301, both `stroke-family:unclassified`), this segment's own stroke family resolved to `pen-weight-prior` with `confidence:0.5` -- a partial improvement, but `size_missing` still applies (this project's own file-wide blank-layer-names cause, already established by the MH102 golden, continues to block automatic size/system binding even where stroke classification itself partially succeeds). A manual size override is used, following the same file-specific precedent `navfac-mh101-heldout.json` and `navfac-mh102.json` both already established. The run's own bench-style reseed (40% into its single segment) was independently re-verified live and reproduces the identical result.
scope: A single real 6-inch round exhaust-air (EA) duct connector (6.37 LF) on the NAVFAC Cherry Point ATC Tower project's own Mechanical Ductwork Plan - Floor 1, sheet MH121, from a real elbow at exhaust fan EF-T1's own duct connection to a real elbow where the duct turns to run horizontally toward another branch. Explicitly OUT OF SCOPE: the horizontal duct run beyond the second elbow; the fan connection and grille assembly at EF-T1 itself; every other run on this real 75-sheet plan set (only sheet 14/MH121 sampled, in addition to the pre-existing held-out sheet 6/MH101 and this session's own sheet 7/MH102); this file's own two other rejected candidates this session (an unbound chilled-water pipe run on sheet MP104, and an unbound chilled-water main on a mechanical-room section, sheet M-301) -- both real, disclosed, not used.

runs.description: 6-inch round exhaust-air (EA) duct connector, from a real elbow at exhaust fan EF-T1's own duct connection to a real elbow turning toward another branch.
